description: An expander for UT-P, placed immediately to the right of it, taking its own separately chosen channel from the same polyphonic input

inputs.text: Chooses which channel of the polyphonic signal in the UT-P is passed, with the voltage range set on the menu spread evenly over the channels and the nearest one taken

outputs.text: A 1ms pulse at 10V at the moment the chosen channel changes
The chosen channel of the polyphonic signal arriving from the left, as one mono voltage

notes: It reads the polyphonic signal from the module on its left, which has to be a UT-P or another UT-OX in a chain running back to one. On its own the output stays at 0V.
menu: Voltage Range: 0V - 10V, 0V - 5V, 0V - 1V, -10V - 10V, -5V - 5V, -2.5V - 2.5V, -1V - 1V — sets the span of CV that is spread across the channels; a new module starts at 0V - 10V
